w: Swamishri arrived at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir in Glen Ellyn. An annakut had been offered before Thakorji. Swamishri joined in the singing of thaal, then performed arti and blessed the congregation.
In the evening, as part of Children's Day program, balaks presented a cultural program of dance and the Prahlad ballet. Swamishri conducted the 'Oiya' game and pleased the balaks.

The BAPS Satsang center in Junagadh was first established in 1965. Therafter, Swamishri consecrated a Hari mandir in 1975. As the following grew, the need for a shikharbaddh mandir arose and a few years ago the Sanstha acquired 52 acres of land. Today, Swamishri arrived for the shilanyas ceremony or the stone-laying ceremony. According to the ancient Indian architectural science, sculpted stone blocks, each symbolic of different gods of earth, were ritualistically placed. Swamishri, senior sadhus and leading devotees performed the shilanyas rituals. Swamishri also performed pujan of 'nidhi kumbh' for the stone-laying ceremony for mandirs in Jetpur and Kisumu (Kenya). Swamishri then placed the 'nidhi kumb' in the main pit of the mandir foundation and filled the pit with cement. Then Swamishri touched the main shila (stone) while it was being placed above the pit, then placed Thakorji on it and performed arti. While Swamishri was performing the rituals in the foundation pit, more than 4,500 sponsors seated beneath a huge canopy were performing pujan of bricks to be placed in the foundation pit. During the assembly, dignitaries addresed the gathering. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Through the wish of Shriji Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami had stayed in Junagadh. Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj had also blessed people with their darshan and satsang. "Girnar is a land of ascetics. So there is a touring of sadhus here and the celebration of festivals. And today we have had here the stone-laying ritual for a mandir. Congratulations to you all for coming here to avail of the ceremony ..." More than 12,000 devotees and wellwishers had participated in today's function.
In the evening, Swamishri blessed a convention of 3,000 members of GEB (Gujarat Electricity Board) Engineers Association.
Thereafter, Swamishri arrived at the evening satsang assembly at Lions Hill Resort.
In the evening assembly, children performed a march dance and a drama 'A Lion Eats Grass.' Finally, Swamishri discoursed about the need to have character in life.

After lunch, Swamishri blessed Rajnikant Patel, a devotee who has read the entire Vachanamrut 260 times. Swamishri said, “You have read the Vachanamrut 260 times, so Maharaj will be pleased and you will attain spiritual wisdom.”

In the evening assembly, Uhuru Kenyatta, who is the son of former Prime Minister, Jomo Kenyatta and current leader of the Opposition, came to meet Swamishri. Swamishri talked to him about his meeting in 1974 with his father, saying, “I had met your father and in Mombasa we stayed in your bungalow. At that time we also remembered you.” Uhuru Kenyatta commented, “I am grateful that you accepted my prayers and sanctified our home.”

Shri Satish Gujral, Renowned Architect and Artist, wrote, “I am otherwise not a believer, but there are times when you see such a thing that you have to make yourself believe that there is something like Providence which gives man such power to create such a place. This place, as I am told, is created in just 5 years. I am not only an artist but an architect and I have seen projects being built. And seeing the limitations and style in India, I think normally it would have taken 50 years to build such a thing. It is a very beautiful place, very well planned and as I told you before it can make a non-believer become a believer.

Venkatpati Kutumb Shastri, Vice-Chancellor of Rashtriya Sanskrut Sansthan, revealed, “Through the wish and austerity of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the mandir that I have seen serves the ‘taste’ of wonder. It can be compared to the cosmic form of God as described in the 11th chapter of Bhagvad Gita.”

A devotee informed Swamishri that he was shortly due for retirement from work. “What will you do after that?” Swamishri asked. “Rest,” the devotee replied casually. “How can you just rest! Won’t you worship God? Because God will give you time, so make a point to worship Him. Come regularly to the mandir. You will have a long rest when you go to Akshardham. So make sure that you do not miss in worshipping and engaging yourself with God.” Swamishri gave a clear programme for dedicating oneself to God after retirement.

Tilak Desai recently migrated from Vadodara to pursue his school studies in London. His academic performance was excellent. He had picked up the English language quite well. On learning of this Swamishri advised him, “It is fine that you advance in English. Speak in English at school and outside, but never forget Gujarati. Speak Gujarati at home. Also, speak in Gujarati with the sadhus. Otherwise you will forget it.” Tilak informed Swamishri, “After your letter I have been regularly attending the weekly satsang assembly. And ever since you told me I’ve been writing to you once a month.” Swamishri untiringly endeavours in preserving and transmitting our language and culture to the new generation.
4 devotees from Rajkot pilgrimaged on foot. 15 devotees pilgrimaged on foot from the suburb of Sahajanand Para.

During the walk, Kalyanmurti Swami presented before Pramukh Swami Maharaj the four incidents that Shastriji Maharaj used to tell, by which half of lust, anger and the like are burnt away. Swamishri was pleased.

After these incidents were over, Harinarayan Swami asked, "We have heard the four incidents of Shastriji Maharaj. Which are four such incidents of yours, which if we remember daily, lust, anger and the like will lessen?"
Viveksagar Swami said, "With Shastriji Maharaj's incidents, half of lust, anger and the like lessen; the other half will go by remembering your incidents, so please tell us your incidents."
Swamishri said, "These that were told, those are it! Those are the real incidents. Remembering them includes everything."

Harinarayan Swami said, "Now the whole satsang community is connected with you. Everyone gains understanding by hearing your incidents. So they have love for you. Everyone expects your incidents, so please tell them."

Swamishri said, "Tell Shastriji Maharaj's incidents; everything is included in them. There is nothing new to say. There is nothing new at all. Not, this one says 'my four' and that one says 'my four'. Everything is included in one."
In this way Swamishri was avoiding talking of his own incidents.
Meanwhile Viveksagar Swami said, "Many years ago such a talk took place once. At that time I remember a little that you told some four incidents. One is the incident of Shastriji Maharaj's medicine."

Since Viveksagar Swami made a start in this way, the talk turned that way. Swamishri too began to tell that incident. So the sadhus said, "Everyone knows that incident, so that is one, but which is the second?"
The sadhus themselves mentioned the incident when "the Amrut Mahotsav was celebrated in Gondal and Yogiji Maharaj embraced Swamishri". So Swamishri began telling that incident too.
Stopping him midway, the sadhus said, "Which is the third?"
Swamishri said, "The one in Atladra about the lime, that we tell!"
The sadhus said, "The fourth?"
Swamishri said, "When Ghanshyam Maharaj gave darshan!"
Finally Viveksagar Swami said again, "Shastriji Maharaj gave you a mala, and at Yogiji Maharaj's word you gave up your resolve."
Swamishri began to tell that incident too.
In a way, Swamishri agreed with each of the incidents mentioned, and also reminded them of some incidents himself. A new recipe for becoming completely free of desires was found.
